fields.description: Stored per-file checksum word; mirrors checksums[] entry slot0_checksum (sum16_le_inv, seed 0x4455 over payload 8..103). Written by FUN_08090718/FUN_080907e0, verified by FUN_08090878/FUN_08090b40.

fields.name: slot0_stored_checksum

fields.description: Slot occupation flag: 0 shows an empty '___' entry, nonzero copies name/stage into the slot menu.
fields.evidence: FUN_0806ae80 reads image byte *DAT_0806af64+0x7c (save-file payload+0): zero branches to the empty-slot path, nonzero copies +0x7d..+0x7f and stage bits to the menu. Set to 1 for new games by FUN_080693c0 (*(+0x7c)=1).
fields.name: slot0_active

fields.description: 3-character slot label shown in the save-slot menu ('---' default, '___' when empty).
fields.evidence: FUN_0806ae80 copies image bytes +0x7d..+0x7f (payload+1..3) into the slot-menu entry; FUN_080693c0 initializes them to 0x2D ('-'). Empty slots render 0x5F ('_').
fields.name: slot0_name

fields.description: Fresh-slot marker: 0xFF while a slot is freshly initialized; gates the continue-vs-load path. 0x00 when cleared.
fields.evidence: FUN_080693c0 writes 0xFF to save-struct byte +0x80 (payload+4); FUN_08069500 branches on *(+0x80)==-1 (continue path) vs load path. EEPROM clear/format paths store 0x00.
fields.name: slot0_fresh_flag

fields.description: Cached per-stage parameter byte looked up from a ROM table by the 5-bit stage index; refreshed on load and new-game.
fields.evidence: FUN_080693c0 and FUN_08069500 store FUN_0806b560() into save-struct byte +0x82 (payload+6); FUN_0806b560 returns DAT_0806b584[stage*4+1] where stage=((+0xd8&3)<<3)|(+0xd7>>5).
fields.name: slot0_stage_param

fields.description: 75 collectible/event flags (ids 0..74): bit set by event id via FUN_080698b8; full range initialized by new-game FUN_0806b8c4.
fields.evidence: FUN_080698b8 sets bit (param_1) in save-struct bytes +0x90+uVar6 (*DAT_08069904, same game-state struct as the save image); FUN_0806b8c4 calls it for ids 0..74 (10+9+10+7+9+10+10+10 across modes 0..7), bounding the array at 75 bits = payload+20..29.
fields.name: slot0_event_flags

fields.description: Progress/status byte: bits 5-7 stage index high, bits 2-4 level-step counter, bits 0-1 sub-counter.
fields.evidence: Save-struct byte +0xd7 (payload+91): FUN_0806ae80 and FUN_0806b508 use (+0xd7>>5) as stage bits; FUN_080698b8 and FUN_08069b5c mode 2 increment bits 2-4; FUN_08069b5c mode 3 increments bits 0-1; FUN_0806b8c4 initializes it.
fields.name: slot0_progress_low

fields.description: Stage index low 2 bits; combined 5-bit stage = ((high&3)<<3)|(low>>5), used for stage select.
fields.evidence: Save-struct byte +0xd8 (payload+92): FUN_0806ae80 computes stage bits from (*( +0xd8)&3)<<3; FUN_0806b508 and FUN_0806b560 use the same pair for stage-select lookup.
fields.name: slot0_progress_high
